denomination.title: Which tradition do you belong to?

errors.tooManyGifts: Choose at most three spiritual gifts.

bio.helper: What do you love about your faith? What are you praying for?

requirements.title: Add a clear face photo
requirements.body: We require a clear photo of your face so others can connect with the real you. Please avoid body-only photos.

rejection.no_face_detected: We couldn't see a face in your photo. Please try a photo where your face is clearly visible.
rejection.face_too_small: Your face appears small in this photo. Please try a closer photo where your face is clearly visible.
rejection.multiple_faces: We saw more than one person. Please upload a photo of just you.
rejection.low_confidence: We couldn't get a clear read on the photo. Please try another.
rejection.unsafe: This photo doesn't meet our community standards. Please review the Holy Code of Conduct and try another.

rejection.block: This bio doesn't meet our community standards. Please review the Holy Code of Conduct and try again.
rejection.review: Thank you. Our team is reviewing your bio. You'll be notified shortly.
